_comment: Octail's own egg (no upstream file). Uptime Kuma, the self-hosted uptime monitor: the install downloads the source of a pinned release from GitHub, checked against the SHA-256 recorded in the script (GitHub publishes none for source archives; staff can set one for another version in the hidden KUMA_SHA256), and the release's prebuilt web interface (dist.tar.gz), checked against the SHA-256 digest the GitHub API lists, into app/; data/ (the SQLite database) stays on a reinstall. The start installs the production dependencies with npm ci when the Node.js version or package-lock.json changed, then runs server/server.js on the main port with SQLite (UPTIME_KUMA_DB_TYPE=sqlite skips the database setup page). It reads no console input and stops on Ctrl+C. The start is its 'Listening on' line or the TCP port once bound.
name: Uptime Kuma
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Uptime Kuma: a self-hosted monitoring tool with a web interface. Checks websites, ports, game servers and more, with status pages and notifications (Discord, Telegram, email, ...). Pinned, checksum-checked release; open the web address after the first start to create the admin account.

startup_commands.Default: export DATA_DIR="$(pwd)/data/" UPTIME_KUMA_DB_TYPE=sqlite; if [ ! -f app/server/server.js ]; then echo '[Octail] app/ is missing: reinstall the server.'; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p data; cd app || exit 1; STAMP="$(node -v) $(sha256sum package-lock.json | cut -c1-16)"; if [ "$(cat node_modules/.octail-installed 2>/dev/null)" != "${STAMP}" ]; then echo '[Octail] Installing the Node.js dependencies (npm ci; a few minutes on the first start)'; npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "${STAMP}" > node_modules/.octail-installed; fi; exec node server/server.js --port={{SERVER_PORT}} --host=0.0.0.0

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Uptime Kuma installation script (Octail's own): the source of a pinned release from GitHub, checked against the
# SHA-256 recorded below (GitHub publishes none for source archives), and the release's prebuilt web interface
# (dist.tar.gz), checked against the SHA-256 digest the GitHub API lists. The program goes into app/ and is replaced on
# a reinstall; the monitors, settings and history in data/ stay. The Node.js dependencies are installed at the next
# start (npm ci, in the runtime image). Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

VERSION="${KUMA_VERSION:-2.5.7}"
## SHA-256 of github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/archive/refs/tags/<version>.tar.gz, recorded by Octail on 2026-10-23
case "$VERSION" in
    2.5.7) SUM=501371f8f3a39bced0a8063119ec5a4d9afacf46a338f61cab66a518798de8ae ;;
    2.5.6) SUM=a7b5f425f6b8b7e541e79f6ff71642af45f25bd3f5d97574441a2b9b6c78e408 ;;
    2.5.5) SUM=ce47ce2d70049fa4ee2da67303fd3f35a3a68522bba17f046b29bcfe38d8d0c0 ;;
    *) SUM="${KUMA_SHA256:-}" ;;
esac
if [ -z "$SUM" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: Octail has no recorded checksum for Uptime Kuma ${VERSION} (2.5.5 to 2.5.7 are known)."
    echo "Staff can check the release's source archive and set its SHA-256 in Uptime Kuma Source SHA-256."
    exit 1
fi

TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
SRC="https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/archive/refs/tags/${VERSION}.tar.gz"
echo "Downloading Uptime Kuma ${VERSION} from ${SRC}"
if ! curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 -o "$TMP/source.tar.gz" "$SRC"; then
    echo "Installation failed: Uptime Kuma ${VERSION} couldn't be downloaded (check the version)."
    exit 1
fi
if ! echo "${SUM}  $TMP/source.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    echo "Installation failed: the source archive doesn't match its recorded SHA-256."
    exit 1
fi
echo "Source checksum OK."

if ! RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL --proto '=https' "https://api.github.com/repos/louislam/uptime-kuma/releases/tags/${VERSION}"); then
    echo "Installation failed: GitHub has no release ${VERSION} of Uptime Kuma."
    exit 1
fi
DIST_URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "dist.tar.gz") | .browser_download_url')
DIST_DIGEST=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "dist.tar.gz") | .digest // empty')
case "$DIST_URL" in
    https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/releases/download/*) ;;
    *)
        echo "Installation failed: release ${VERSION} has no dist.tar.gz."
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
case "$DIST_DIGEST" in
    sha256:*) ;;
    *)
        echo "Installation failed: GitHub lists no SHA-256 for release ${VERSION}'s dist.tar.gz."
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
if ! curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 3 -o "$TMP/dist.tar.gz" "$DIST_URL"; then
    echo "Installation failed: the web interface (dist.tar.gz) couldn't be downloaded."
    exit 1
fi
if ! echo "${DIST_DIGEST#sha256:}  $TMP/dist.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    echo "Installation failed: dist.tar.gz doesn't match the SHA-256 GitHub lists."
    exit 1
fi
echo "Web interface checksum OK (SHA-256 from GitHub)."

mkdir "$TMP/app"
tar -xzf "$TMP/source.tar.gz" --strip-components=1 -C "$TMP/app"
tar -xzf "$TMP/dist.tar.gz" -C "$TMP/app"
if [ ! -f "$TMP/app/server/server.js" ] || [ ! -f "$TMP/app/dist/index.html" ] || [ ! -f "$TMP/app/package-lock.json" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: the release is missing server/server.js, dist/index.html or package-lock.json."
    exit 1
fi

## the program only: data/ (the SQLite database, uploads, settings) stays
cd /mnt/server
rm -rf app
mv "$TMP/app" app
mkdir -p data

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: Uptime Kuma ${VERSION}."
echo "The first start installs the Node.js dependencies; then open the web address to create the admin account."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Uptime Kuma Version
variables.description: The release to install, such as 2.5.7. Versions 2.5.5 to 2.5.7 have a checksum in the install script; others need staff to set one. Reinstall to switch; monitors and history stay.

variables.name: Uptime Kuma Source SHA-256
variables.description: Uptime Kuma publishes no checksum for its source archives. The install script carries the SHA-256 of the 2.5.5 to 2.5.7 archives Octail checked; for another version, download https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/archive/refs/tags/<version>.tar.gz, check it, and put its SHA-256 here. Empty: only the recorded versions install.
